synopsis: CarMaker/TruckMaker and IPG’s off-highway stack are commercial, near-complete simulation offerings targeting construction, agriculture and mining, with closed-loop vehicle, driver, environment and sensor simulation for MIL/SIL/HIL/VIL [f8347, f15894, f8436, f8989]. The stack supports camera, radar, lidar and other environment sensors plus actuator and ECU coupling; it fits rigid-vehicle and system dynamics well, but high-fidelity deformable soil and particle interaction are not its main role [f8440, f8443]. Vendor-claimed off-highway applications include Linde lidar accident prevention and tractor vehicle-in-the-loop, but independent evidence for severe dust, snow or glare on heavy machines was not found [f15893, f8444]. The only ultrasonic simulation validation found was Schmoll et al. (2024), comparing a CarMaker model against a real Continental sensor; although labeled independent on-road evidence, it included IPG and Continental authors, and publicly accessible details do not establish performance across the requested heavy-off-road weather and soiling matrix [f4761, f4575, f4577]. Integration routes include AVxcelerate Sensors co-simulation and RoadRunner environment exports, although RoadRunner’s base editor remains road-oriented [f15946, f15999, f8701]. The latest CarMaker release found was version 15.0, dated 2025; IPG offers consulting and engineering, but public prices and CarMaker frame rates were not found [f8994, f8806, f8993, f4957].
